subject: BrightPeak onboarding: compact proof chunking + evidence indexing request
messages:
From: Jared Liu <jared@brightpeak.com>
To: kimberly_park@redwoodinference.com
Cc: security_ops@brightpeak.com
Date: Mon, 19 Jul 2027 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Onboarding: compact proof chunks for Archer profile (initial sketch)

Hi Kimberly,

Thanks for taking this on. We're starting Archer portal onboarding this week and wanted to propose a slightly different evidence upload approach to keep the profile compact while preserving traceability. Our security ops team can export a flat S3 manifest but the Archer upload UI struggles with very large single-file bundles.

High-level ask: can Redwood accept a chunked evidence format — a small manifest csv plus multiple small proof objects (PDFs/CSVs) — and map those to CAIQ/SIG questions during onboarding? If so, we'd like guidance on required fields in the manifest and any recommended naming conventions so our ops team can script the export.

I've attached a sample S3 manifest extract and a short note on our current export layout.

Attachments: brightpeak_s3_manifest.csv (CSV, sample 2KB), export-readme.txt (TXT, 1KB)

Thanks,
Jared Liu
Head of Security Integrations
BrightPeak Health

From: kimberly_park <kimberly_park@redwoodinference.com>
To: Jared Liu <jared@brightpeak.com>
Cc: marissa_cole@redwoodinference.com, markus_klein@redwoodinference.com
Date: Mon, 19 Jul 2027 10:04:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Onboarding: compact proof chunks for Archer profile (initial sketch)

Hi Jared — appreciate the clear ask and the sample manifest. We can definitely support a manifest + chunked artifacts approach; the portal mapping is tolerant but our intake pipeline needs a few consistent fields.

I'll loop in Marissa (portal onboarding lead) and Markus (evidence governance) so we can give a concise manifest spec. Quick notes from me while others join:
- Required manifest columns: object_key, sha256_hash, evidence_type, captured_date, related_question_id
- Keep individual proof objects <= 5MB where possible (portal timeout reasons)
- If items map to multiple SIG/CAIQ questions, include a pipe-delimited related_question_id field

Can you confirm whether BrightPeak can include SHA256 in the manifest? Also, do you have a canonical field we can use for the evidence "owner" (e.g., security_team vs archive_service)?

Thanks — kimberly
Kimberly Park
Trust & Compliance Manager | Redwood Inference

From: marissa_cole <marissa_cole@redwoodinference.com>
To: kimberly_park <kimberly_park@redwoodinference.com>, Jared Liu <jared@brightpeak.com>
Cc: markus_klein@redwoodinference.com, mina_haddad@redwoodinference.com
Date: Mon, 19 Jul 2027 11:18:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Onboarding: compact proof chunks for Archer profile (manifest spec + sample mapping)

Hi all — attaching a short manifest spec and an example evidence-map-template.xlsx that shows how we reconcile manifest rows to CAIQ question ids and portal QNA entries.

Practical checklist for scripting the BrightPeak export:
1) Produce CSV manifest with the fields Kimberly listed. If a field is unknown, use "unknown" not blank.
2) Include SHA256 and file size bytes (portal uses size-based timeout heuristics).
3) For multi-question artifacts, add related_question_id as pipe-separated IDs.
4) Place chunks under /brightpeak/archer-onboard/<upload-batch-id>/ in S3 and give read-only presigned URLs in the manifest if possible.
5) Upload small batches (recommended 200 artifacts / batch) and confirm the batch id in the manifest header.

Marissa added: we'll stage a private intake S3 for the first two batches so we can validate mapping before you push to production. Once mapped, we can trigger Archer's bulk QNA import and mark items as attached to CAIQ answers.

I've attached: indexing_guidelines_v1.pdf (PDF), evidence-map-template.xlsx (XLSX).

Next steps: Jared — can you share a 10–15 minute window Tuesday for a quick handoff with our intake engineer?

—Marissa
Marissa Cole
Portal Onboarding Lead | Redwood Inference

From: markus_klein <markus_klein@redwoodinference.com>
To: kimberly_park <kimberly_park@redwoodinference.com>, marissa_cole <marissa_cole@redwoodinference.com>, Jared Liu <jared@brightpeak.com>
Cc: mina_haddad@redwoodinference.com
Date: Tue, 20 Jul 2027 08:55:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Onboarding: compact proof chunks for Archer profile (manifest spec + sample mapping)

Quick operational comment: please ensure BrightPeak includes a consistent captured_date format (ISO-8601) and the sha256 is lowercase hex. Our evidence dedupe and later rotation automation depends on those exact fields; mismatches will create duplicate evidences in the portal and break retention reconciliation.

Also: if you expect to redact PII from PDFs, add a redaction_version column to the manifest (example values: none, redacted_v1). That helps our compliance team validate redaction consistency.

I'll coordinate retention tagging once the first two batches are ingested.

-Markus
Markus Klein
Head of Evidence Governance | Redwood Inference
